import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

np.random.seed(42)
n_simulations = 10000
n_per_group = 30

p_values_null = []
for _ in range(n_simulations):
    group_A = np.random.randn(n_per_group)
    group_B = np.random.randn(n_per_group)
    _, p = stats.ttest_ind(group_A, group_B)
    p_values_null.append(p)

p_values_null = np.array(p_values_null)

false_positive_rate = np.mean(p_values_null < 0.05)

p_values_alt = []
for _ in range(n_simulations):
    group_A = np.random.randn(n_per_group)
    group_B = np.random.randn(n_per_group) + 0.5
    _, p = stats.ttest_ind(group_A, group_B)
    p_values_alt.append(p)

p_values_alt = np.array(p_values_alt)

power = np.mean(p_values_alt < 0.05)

n_tests = 20
alpha = 0.05
prob_at_least_one_fp = 1 - (1 - alpha)**n_tests

bonferroni_alpha = alpha / n_tests

print(f"False positive rate (under H0): {false_positive_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Statistical power (under H1): {power:.4f}")
print(f"P(at least 1 FP in {n_tests} tests): {prob_at_least_one_fp:.4f}")
print(f"Bonferroni-corrected alpha: {bonferroni_alpha:.4f}")
